STP.note: Links health information system to civil registration, not the civil register to the ID system.
Says nothing of how births or deaths are registered.
A health-sector interoperability layer, not a government-wide exchange platform.

systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Informação de Saúde (DHIS2-based)

STP.note: Names the national health information system but states nothing on facility reporting, tiers or patient records in use.

facts.fact: Saudigitus says it is developing, with SIS-STP and UNDP support, an interoperability layer integrating the National Health Information System with the Civil Registration System to share birth and death data.
facts.system: Interoperability layer (National Health Information System - Civil Registration System)

STP.note: Names the national system but does not say facilities report through it; the link to civil registration is in development.
No ID number at birth mentioned.
Nothing on how local registry offices enter events.
